dct_title_s: Plan of Lands Situated in West Deptford Township, Gloucester County, New Jersey
dct_description_sm: Map shows the Fancy Hill Real Estate Company on Big Timber Creek.
Map shows Riparian Commissioners Exterior Line, along Big Timber Creek and Delaware River. Map also shows low water line of Big Timber Creek and old Washington Park Pier.
